Read the route

Open farmland and long, forgiving bends.

Find time

Learn a repeatable line on GAS first. Use the open exits for BOOST; a long slide is useful for charging, but is not automatically a faster lap.

Start here for steering and BOOST. For sustained drift practice, move to CLIFFSIDE.
